stopPoints.label: Police officers eating donuts at the desk
stopPoints.question:
Q1 (Reason): 'Why did Peppa's family come here?' (Prompt: George lost Mr. Dinosaur) ➔ Guidance: Encourage child to say: 'George lost Mr. Dinosaur!'
Q2 (Food): 'What is Officer Panda eating?' (Prompt: A pink donut / An apple) ➔ Guidance: Encourage child to say: 'He is eating a donut!'
Q3 (Who): 'Who are the two police officers?' (Prompt: Officer Squirrel and Officer Panda) ➔ Guidance: Encourage child to say: 'Officer Squirrel and Officer Panda!'

stopPoints.label: The lost and found room full of strange treasures
stopPoints.question:
Q1 (Place): 'Where are they now?' (Prompt: The Lost and Found room / The park) ➔ Guidance: Encourage child to say: 'The Lost and Found room!'
Q2 (Item): 'What is inside the big open chest?' (Prompt: Shiny gold coins / pirate treasure) ➔ Guidance: Encourage child to say: 'Pirate treasure!'
Q3 (Story): 'Why is there treasure here?' (Prompt: Pirates forgot where they buried it) ➔ Guidance: Encourage child to say: 'Pirates forgot it!'

stopPoints.label: Police officers show lost toy dinosaurs to George
stopPoints.question:
Q1 (Check): 'Are these dinosaurs George's toy?' (Prompt: Yes / No) ➔ Guidance: Encourage child to say: 'No, they aren't!'
Q2 (Feeling): 'How does little George feel right now?' (Prompt: Sad / Happy) ➔ Guidance: Encourage child to say: 'He feels sad.'
Q3 (Color): 'What color is George's real Mr. Dinosaur?' (Prompt: Green / Purple) ➔ Guidance: Encourage child to say: 'Mr. Dinosaur is green!'

stopPoints.label: Mr. Dinosaur is finally found in the car boot
stopPoints.question:
Q1 (Outcome): 'Where did they find Mr. Dinosaur?' (Prompt: In the car boot / Under the table) ➔ Guidance: Encourage child to say: 'In the car boot!'
Q2 (Feeling): 'George has his dinosaur back. Is he happy now?' (Prompt: Yes / No) ➔ Guidance: Encourage child to say: 'Yes, he is very happy!'
Q3 (Item): 'What toy is Peppa holding in her hand?' (Prompt: Teddy / Dinosaur) ➔ Guidance: Encourage child to say: 'She is holding Teddy!'
